meta.name: anti-ui-slop
meta.description: STOP UI SLOP. Grounds coding-agent UI work in UIZZE's 800,000+ real web and iOS screens, writes a product-specific design contract, and rejects generic output at a hard finish gate. Use when the user says "stop UI slop", "make this UI less generic", "ground this design in real products", "build a distinctive interface", or asks for a pre-ship UI finish gate. Do not use for a standards-only accessibility review.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用真实产品界面数据检验UI设计,拒绝通用输出
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果厌倦了AI生成千篇一律的UI,想要基于真实产品数据做设计把关
copy.tagline_en: Validate UI designs against real product screens and reject generic output
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of generic AI-generated UIs and want design grounded in real product data

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会基于 UIZZE 的 80 万真实屏幕截图来设计界面，先写一份产品专属的设计合同，最后用硬性检查门拒绝通用输出。
howto.when: 当你说“停止 UI 泛化”、“让这个设计更独特”等关键词，或要求进行发布前 UI 检查时触发。

say.text: 帮我建一个分析仪表盘，但要停止 UI 泛化。
这个页面太通用，用真实产品来重新设计。
对这个 iOS 屏幕运行发布前检查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude grounds UI work in UIZZE's 800,000+ real web and iOS screens, writes a product-specific design contract, and rejects generic output at a hard finish gate.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "stop UI slop", "make this UI less generic", "ground this design in real products", "build a distinctive interface", or ask for a pre-ship UI finish gate.

say_en.text: Build this analytics dashboard, but stop the usual UI slop.
This page feels generic. Ground the redesign in real products.
Run a finish gate on this iOS screen before we ship.
say_en.note: Claude compares with design contract and iOS evidence, lists and fixes blockers.
